articulation.label: sunset
articulation.alt: sunset: /s/ → /ʌ/ → /n/ → /s/ → /ɛ/ → /t/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /s/: Make a narrow gap near the ridge; let air flow.
/ʌ/: Tongue central; jaw comfortably open.
/n/: Tip at the ridge; air goes through the nose.
/s/: Make a narrow gap near the ridge; let air flow.
/ɛ/: Front tongue; open the jaw a little more.
/t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

articulation.label: bedtime
articulation.alt: bedtime: /b/ → /ɛ/ → /d/ → /t/ → /aɪ/ → /m/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /b/: Close lips briefly; release into the next vowel.
/ɛ/: Front tongue; open the jaw a little more.
/d/: Tip touches the ridge; add voice and release.
/t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
/a/: Start with the tongue low and jaw open.
/ɪ/: Glide up and forward; narrow the jaw gap.
/m/: Close both lips; air goes through the nose.
articulation.note: Keep each vowel glide inside one syllable.

articulation.label: backpack
articulation.alt: backpack: /b/ → /æ/ → /k/ → /p/ → /æ/ → /k/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /b/: Close lips briefly; release into the next vowel.
/æ/: Low front tongue; open the jaw.
/k/: Back of tongue meets the soft palate; release.
/p/: Close the lips, then release the air.
/æ/: Low front tongue; open the jaw.
/k/: Back of tongue meets the soft palate; release.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

articulation.label: sunlight
articulation.alt: sunlight: /s/ → /ʌ/ → /n/ → /l/ → /aɪ/ → /t/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /s/: Make a narrow gap near the ridge; let air flow.
/ʌ/: Tongue central; jaw comfortably open.
/n/: Tip at the ridge; air goes through the nose.
/l/: Tip at the ridge; air passes round the sides.
/a/: Start with the tongue low and jaw open.
/ɪ/: Glide up and forward; narrow the jaw gap.
/t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
articulation.note: Keep each vowel glide inside one syllable.

cards.title: Five words to hear and use

the part of the day after noon. Mia has no afternoon class.
the later part of the day before night. Her English class is in the evening at six.
the meal eaten in the morning. Puck eats breakfast at home.
the main meal of the day often eaten in the evening. Mia cooks dinner in the evening.
